answer: Unique resource attestation provides Sybil resistance for AI agent economies. Each agent must possess a scarce, non-fungible token representing validated, unique contribution or computational proof-of-work, much like a rare violet bloom found in a vast digital river. This verifiable stake ensures each identity carries a significant, non-replicable economic cost. Attacking requires acquiring or forging these tokens for every Sybil, an immense economic barrier making mass identity creation prohibitive, transforming the network into a secure oasis of verified entities.
